headline:
مفاجأة في جوجل (Google)
قبل إطلاق Ocarina of Time
label: جديد
lowres_ok: Nintendo's Switch 2 store trailers (US nsuid 70010000130792, 1280x720, three videos) are the only official copies; Nintendo's YouTube channel is not reachable here (sign-in wall) and no 1080p press-kit file is public
note: Story: Google search 'Ocarina of Time' shows a small Master Sword icon; clicking it sends the results page back to a 1998 look (blocky links, old search bar, exclamation-marked logo). Sources: Nintendo Life (read, 2 Nov 12:30Z), IGN and Ars Technica and CNET headlines (13 outlets). The egg itself is not shown (Google not reachable here; no outlet footage reused); footage: Overview Trailer shots 128 to 134 s and 9 to 27 s, clear of the Geekay Reel's 27 to 41 s and the interview Reel's 187 to 212 s. v2: Google takes the Arabic and Latin forms at first mention (grammar stage); the credit is a footage credit.
